entries.title: ADVANCE
entries.body:
ADVANCE
Author: Command Master
Keywords: advance 
Type: Command

Syntax: advance [units] - advances forwards in a room at max units unless specified. 1 unit = 5 feet.
Syntax: advance <target> - advances forwards to the target.
Use assess to see the current location situation.


The advance command allows you to move forward in a room by a number of units. Engaged NPCs
will try to ensure they are always in attack range. If using a ranged weapon, it is best to
advance or retreat prior to starting combat. You may see the current location of all NPCs
and players in a room by using the assess command.

See: help retreat, help move, help assess, help fire, help ranger

entries.title: ANALYZE
entries.body:
ANALYZE
Author: Command Master
Keywords: analyze diagnose
Type: Command

Syntax: analyze - analyizes all players and npcs in the room.
Syntax: analyze <target>|self [full] - analyizes the player or npc in the room. Use the full option to show affects on the target.
Syntax: analyze <target>|self affects - analyizes the player's affects.
Syntax: analyze <target>|self myaffects - analyizes the player's affects you put on them.
Note: You may shorthand the above (full, affects, myaffects) for easier typing.
Note: You may also use 'self' to target you.


The analyze command allows a player to view important diagnostic information on a target.

This information includes condition (ie: near death), affects, and so on.

Analyze is a vital command to playing utility and healing classes such as Clerics and
Arcanists.

See: help group, help class ats.commands.informative.HealthCommand,

entries.title: ASSESS

ASSESS

and how many units you may move at a time.

entries.title: BARBARIAN
entries.body:
BARBARIAN
Type: Class
Keywords: Barbarian
Difficulty: EASY
Role: Damage, Tank
Allowed Races: Anthian, Arachnian, Drag-al, Flerian, Go-blin, Go-blin-al, Hithual, Human,
Monitanian, Muatana-al, Oog-ra, Psycian, San Elf, Thugian
Specializations: None

Barbarians are powerful melee combatants distinguished by their signature Berserk ability.
When sufficiently wounded in combat, they enter an uncontrolled frenzy that dramatically


amplifies their damage output and attack speed. However, this berserker state comes at a
cost - they lose control and become consumed by combat instinct. Once the frenzy ends,
severe fatigue follows.


To learn more about the Barbarian please visit the web page:
http://dragonsgatereborn.com/classes/class-barbarian.html


See: help class ats.commands.combat.DispatchCommand, help skills, help class
ats.commands.informative.AttackInfoCommand, help <race name>, help classes, help
specialization

entries.title: CALL
entries.body:
CALL
Author: Command Master
Keywords: call pets animal tag mounts
Type: Command

Syntax: call <item> - summons the pet on a pet tag or mount on a mount tag!
Syntax: call <slot> - summons the pet on a pet tag or mount on a mount tag!
Syntax: call patreonPet - summons the patreon pet, if one is made. Use the Patreon command to create a pet!
Syntax: call patreonMount - summons and mounts the patreon mount, if one is made. Use the Patreon command to create a mount! (Tier 5)

Syntax: call dismiss [longID]|all - dismisses your current pet. If the tag was a single use, this pet will be lost forever.
Syntax: call list - List the pets and their LongID so you can dismiss or interact with them via order.
Syntax: call pets - calls for your already existing pets and has them returns to you! This won't work if the pets are in combat.
Syntax: call resonance - summons your already existing resonance to you!


The call command summons a mount, a new pet, dismisses a pet, or returns a lost pet to your
side.

Typically, pets and mounts must be purchased or acquired through a role play event. They
can then be summoned with the call command and controlled with the order command.

Pets can perish and be lost forever. Be careful of giving them rare and expensive items as
they can be easily lost as pet inventory is not saved. Mounts do not perish and last
forever.

See: help order, help class ats.commands.items.PatreonCommand, help dismount, help role
play

entries.title: COLOR
entries.body:
COLOR
Author: Command Master
Keywords: color colorset ansi colors colours
Type: Command

Syntax: color set <type> <colorTag>|default - sets the given type to use the indicated color tag.
Syntax: color list - lists all current colors.

Syntax: color brief - toggles brief color on/off.
Syntax: color none - toggles no color on/off.
Syntax: color xterm - toggles xterm color(256 colors - need client support) on/off.
Syntax: color trueColor - toggles true color on/off and xterm on if off.


The color command can change many aspects of color in A Tempest Season.

The following color codes exist:
#c/#C: cyan/bright cyan
#r/#R: red/bright red
#g/#G: green/bright green
#b/#B: blue/bright blue
#p/#P: purple/bright purple
#y/#Y: yellow/bright yellow
#s/#S: gray/black
#w/#W: gray/white
#d: default color
#h: default highlight color
#x: terminates color and reverts to client's default


The game also supports xterm color (type: color xterm to turn on):
#e1 to #e255: a specific color, that matches the chart from the following website:
https://i.stack.imgur.com/KTSQa.png

The game also supports true color (type: color trueColor to turn on):
#t(6-digit hex code): a specific color that matches the hex code in rgb color space. Example: #t(e3cdb6)
#t[keyword]: a specific color that matches the keyword. Example: #t[cotton]
 Note: Keywords are added by Actinate and Dayrinni. Not all keywords will exist.

See: help put, help get, help look,

entries.title: DELAY
entries.body:
DELAY
Author: Command Master
Keywords: delay delays stun
Type: Command

Syntax: delay - displays current delay and combat timer.

The delay command shows the current delay and combat timer of a player.

Delays occur when an action takes place, such as swinging a weapon, casting a spell, and,
picking up, unlocking or selling hordes of items.

The combat timer begins whenever a hostile action is performed. Certain commands and
actions are restricted while in a combat timer, such as the quit command.

The delays tick down every second and any commands entered which also are delayed, will be
placed in the queue. Not all commands are delayed actions, and can be performed while in
delay. Commands like say, inventory, and skills are examples for non-delayed commands.

See: help class ats.commands.informative.CoolDownsCommand,

entries.title: DELETE
entries.body:
DELETE
Author: Command Master
Keywords: delete 
Type: Command

Syntax: delete now - begins deletion process.
Syntax: delete confirm - to confirm deletion after 'delete now' is typed.
Syntax: delete cancel - to cancel deletion.


The delete command allows you to remove the character from your account and game world.


This is a two step process and can be completed by typing the following commands:

delete now


delete confirm


In the event of a mistaken deletion, please contact Dayrinni@tempestseason.com for a
restoration request.

See: help quit, help logout,

entries.title: DIE
entries.body:
DIE
Author: Command Master
Keywords: die revive death dying debt resurrect


Type: Command


The die command brings you back to life!

If you have been killed in combat, you may die and return to life. You will be revived at
your religion's temple, or the center of Spur if there is no temple.

Note: If Quest Mode is on, your revive location is the current room.


There are penalties associated with dying if you are over level 10: a debt to your
experience will incur. This debt must be paid back before any progress will resume for the
next level. The current debt can be seen under the score command.

You keep all of your equipment, items, and currency when you die.

(Exploring the game while under level 10 is a good idea since there are no penalties when
dying.)

See: help class ats.commands.informative.ScoreCommand, help experience, help quest mode

entries.title: FIRE
entries.body:
FIRE
Author: Command Master
Keywords: fire volley
Type: Command

Syntax: fire <rapid|deftly|precisely> <target> - fires with the indicated attack. (Can abbr the attack types, ie: r for rapid)
Syntax: fire <direction> <range> - fires a volley in the indicated direction.
Syntax: fire artillery [room cannon] <target> - fires the equipped or room artillery at the target. If the target is out of range, the cannon will still fire.


The fire command is used to fire bows, crossbows and firearms at a target. The weapon
generally requires some form of ammo required, such as a quiver with arrows or bolts, or a
magazine in a fire arm. Bows are automatically loaded from the equipped quiver on each
fire. Crossbows and firearms require a manual reload. Ranged weapons can also be unloaded,
if needed.

Bows recieve a 50% damage bonus if used outside of melee range(2 units (10 feet)) of a
target. Advance or retreat before battle to do maximum damage.

Bows can also be volleyed into other rooms, dealing damage from afar. Damage is reduced by
25%. Be warned, any struck targets will chase after you after taking fire!

To see the differences between rapid, deftly and precisely type: attackinfo

See: help advance, help retreat, help move, help reload, help unload, help class
ats.commands.informative.AttackInfoCommand, help ranger, help risk

entries.title: GET
entries.body:
GET
Author: Command Master
Keywords: get take grab retrieve
Type: Command

Syntax: get <item> - gets an item stack from the room
Syntax: get <item> - gets the #th item stack from the room that matches the item
Syntax: get <#> <item> - gets number of items from the item stack in the room

Syntax: get <slot> - gets an item stack by slot from the room
Syntax: get <#> <slot> - gets number of items from an item stack by slot from the room

Syntax: get all [item] - gets all, or all items with same name as input, of the items from the room

Container Get Syntax is similiar to the above:
Syntax: get [#] <item|slot> <container> [room|inv|eq] - gets an item from the corpse or container
Syntax: get all from <container> [room|inv|eq] - gets all, or all items with same name as input, of the items from the corpse or container
Syntax: get all [item] <container> [room|inv|eq] - gets all, or all items with same name as input, of the items from the corpse or container
Using 'room', 'inv', or 'eq' will ensure an item will only be from that location (the room or your inventory or eq). Optional.


The get command allows a player to pick up an object off the ground or from another object
such as a box or corpse.

To put all of the items on the ground from a corpse, use the 'strip' command. Get does not
work on player corpses, to loot a player corpse, use the 'strip' command.

entries.title: MATERIALS
entries.body:
MATERIALS
Type: Materials
Keywords: Materials,Orinsteel,Platinum,Titanium,Karnite,Miltanium,Metal,Iron Works,Forge,Ore,Ingot,Smelt

A Tempest Season there are several types of rare materials used for high leveled weapons,
armor and shields.

These materials are required to purchase gear upgrades in the Tralisia Merchant District.

1. Acquire a piece of ore: trace or chunk.


2. Go to the Iron Works and have a smith refine the pieces into ingots by using the BUY command.
3. Take the refined ingots to the desired store, weapon or armor, and purchase the item.

Tips for finding ore and ingots is as follows:
Levels 40-69: Orinsteel - Cave and Lake Walkers
Levels 70-100: Platinum - Basin Worms and Ragweed Beasts (best drop rate)
Levels 100: Titanium - Hydras
Levels 100+: Karnite - Dead Oak
Levels 100+: Miltanium - Completing the quest Protect Tralisia: Destroy the Dead Oak Terror Knight and fighting frostbit trolls, ice spiders, and frost wyverns
Levels 100+: Wind-metal and Lightning-metal - Tower of Windis and Lita and the Hall of Elements in the Merchant Distrct
Levels 100+: Frost-metal - Ice Prison and the Hall of Elements in the Merchant Distrct 

The city of Tralisia is always looking to improve their supply and processing of ore and
events occur to do just this so stay tuned!

The following materials and their respective tiers are as follows:

 -  wood (tier 1)
 -  copper (tier 2)
 -  bone (tier 3)
 -  bronze (tier 4)
 -  iron (tier 5)
 -  steel (tier 6)
 -  orinsteel (tier 7)
 -  platinum (tier 8)
 -  titanium (tier 9)
 -  moonsteel (tier 9)
 -  karnite (tier 10)
 -  obsidian (tier 10)
 -  miltanium (tier 11)
 -  frost-metal (tier 11)
 -  lightning-metal (tier 11)
 -  wind-metal (tier 11)
 -  flame-metal (tier 11)
 -  tritanium (tier 12)
 -  anima (tier 20)

Higher tiers mean stronger damage and protection.

See: help equipment, help leveling, help elemental gear

quest info <npc name> - asks the NPC about their quest but does not take it. This will display the start text.
quest return <npc name> - turns in a completed quest to a NPC and receives any rewards.quest journal - lists a summary of your quests.
quest journal <progress|completed|turnedin|all> - lists a summary of the quests in the indicated state. Can abbreviate these, ie: quest j p to view quests in progress.
quest journal view <slot>|all - views a specific quest from the last quest journal display unless all is used
quest visit <npc name> - visits a NPC that's needed for a quest.
quest use <item name> (Have to be in the correct room for this to work)
quest delete <exact quest name> - deletes a quest by the exact name. It's case sensitive.


Questing in A Tempest Season is an exciting and rewarding activity to take part in. The
commands above are how you interact with NPCs and their quests.

First, one must request a quest from a NPC. NPCs who have quests show up with (Quest)
around their names.

Second, after receiving the quest, you must complete the objectives. These may involve
finding items, visiting certain NPCs or rooms, or simply slaying beasts!

Finally, once the quest is finished, return to the original NPC to receive your reward!


You may also view your journal by typing 'quest journal'.

Some quests are difficult to solve - so feel free to ask for help. There are also rare
quests that give rich rewards so be on the look out!

entries.title: QUEUE
entries.body:
QUEUE
Author: Command Master
Keywords: queue 
Type: Command

Syntax: queue clear|c - clears the queue
Syntax: queue list - lists the queue


The queue command manages the commands you send to the game. Any commands received while in
delay will be added to the command queue and automatically executed when the delay ends.

To manage the queue easier, such as automatically clearing the queue after each NPC kill,
type: CONFIG CLEAR_QUEUE_ON_KILL To view a notifcation of when a command is placed in the
queue, type: CONFIG VIEW_COMMAND_QUEUE_MESSAGES

Delays occur when an action takes place, such as swinging a weapon, casting a spell, and,
picking up, unlocking or selling hordes of items.

The delays tick down every second and any commands entered which also are delayed, will be
placed in the queue. Not all commands are delayed actions, and can be performed while in
delay. Commands like say, inventory, and skills are examples for non-delayed commands.

See: help delay, help class ats.commands.informative.CoolDownsCommand, help config,

entries.title: QUIT
entries.body:
QUIT
Author: Command Master
Keywords: quit 
Type: Command

Syntax: quit - disconnects from the game. Your character is automatically saved.


Quit disconnects you from A Tempest Season. Your character will be saved automatically upon
using this command.

You cannot quit during combat or a short time after being in combat.


If you wish to switch to another character without quitting, use the 'logout' command.

See: help logout, help delete,

entries.title: RACES
entries.body:
RACES

A Tempest Season has many races for the player to select from.

Each has their own advantages and disadvantages. While races may start with different
attributes, they end up at the same maximum amount with the exception of dragons who gain
higher caps as they age.

Please see each race's help file for more information.

To learn much more about the races please visit this web page:
https://tempestseason.com/manual/races/

entries.title: RELIGION
entries.body:
RELIGION
Author: Command Master
Keywords: religion 
Type: Command

Syntax: religion - shows current religion


The religion command views the religious information about your character.


Besides the RP information it provides, Clerics can see their progression with their Entity
for then next devotion level. Dragons can use the devote command to follow the religion of
the target player.

See: help class ats.commands.items.DonateCommand, help devotion

entries.title: RELOAD
entries.body:
RELOAD
Author: Command Master
Keywords: reload 
Type: Command

Syntax: reload <item>|<slot> - reloads the currently equipped firearm/crossbow with the indicated magazine.
Syntax: reload <weapon> <item>|<slot> - reloads the firearm/crossbow with the indicated ammo. Equipment and then inventory is checked for the weapon.
   If quiver is specificed for crossbows, it'll remove a bolt from the quiver.
Syntax: reload - reloads the firearm/crossbow automatically (crossbow: equipped quiver, firearm: first non-empty magazine found in the inventory)


The reload command is used to reload crossbows or firearms. Bolts are used from a quiver to
reload a crossbow, while a bullet or magazine are used for fire arms, depending on the
type. These weapons can also be unloaded, if needed.

See: help fire, help unload, help ranger

entries.title: REPLAY
entries.body:
REPLAY
Author: Command Master
Keywords: replay 
Type: Command

Syntax: replay - displays the most recent chat messages.
Syntax: replay CHAT - displays the most recent chat messages.
Syntax: replay NEWBIE - displays the most recent newbie messages.
Syntax: replay DRAGON_LINK - displays the most recent dragon_link messages.
Syntax: replay DEATHBOND - displays the most recent deathbond messages.
Syntax: replay WORSHIP - displays the most recent worship messages.
Syntax: replay WHISPER - displays the most recent whisper messages.
Syntax: replay TELLS - displays the most recent tells messages.
Syntax: replay EMOTE - displays the most recent emote messages.
Syntax: replay SAY - displays the most recent say messages.
Syntax: replay GROUP - displays the most recent group messages.


The replay command allows you to view recent or missed messages.


Some of the messages that can be replayed are: chat, tells, newbie, and says.

See: help chat, help class ats.commands.communication.NewbieChatCommand, help class
ats.commands.communication.DragonLinkCommand, help class ats.commands.DeathbondCommand,
help class ats.commands.WorshipCommand, help whisper, help tellchat, help emote, help say,
help groupchat,

entries.title: RETREAT
entries.body:
RETREAT
Author: Command Master
Keywords: retreat 
Type: Command

Syntax: retreat [units] - retreats backwards in a room at max units unless specified. 1 unit = 5 feet.
Syntax: retreat <target> - retreats backwards to the target.
Use assess to see the current location situation.


The retreat command allows you to move backwards in a room by a number of units. Engaged
NPCs will try to ensure they are always in attack range. If using a ranged weapon, it is
best to advance or retreat prior to starting combat. You may see the current location of
all NPCs and players in a room by using the assess command.

See: help advance, help move, help assess, help fire, help ranger

entries.title: RIPOFF
entries.body:
RIPOFF
Author: Command Master
Keywords: ripoff rip off
Type: Command

Syntax: ripoff <target> - tries to rip off a 'someone' disguise from a player.


The ripoff command tries to remove a disguise from a target.

Ripoff may only be used on a target every once in awhile. The success rate depends on the
attributes of both players.

See: help class ats.commands.informative.ScoreCommand, help disguise

entries.title: RUNE MAGE
entries.body:
RUNE MAGE
Type: Class
Keywords: Rune Mage
Difficulty: MEDIUM
Role: Damage, Control
Allowed Races: Anthian, Drag-al, Flerian, Frontacian, Go-blin, Go-blin-al, Human, Leuian,
Monitanian, Muatana-al, Penthanian, Psycian, San Elf, Secian, Thugian, Usilin
Specializations: None

Rune Mages achieve their power through scholarly discipline and study rather than divine
favor. They excel in both offensive and defensive magic, capable of reshaping battlefields
with area spells despite being physically weaker than martial classes.


To learn more about the Rune Mage please visit the web page:
http://dragonsgatereborn.com/classes/class-runemage.html


See: help class ats.commands.combat.CastCommand, help spells, help <race name>, help
classes, help specialization

entries.title: SCRIBE
entries.body:
SCRIBE
Author: Command Master
Keywords: scribe scroll read
Type: Command

Syntax: scribe <item>|<slot> - scribes the scroll to your memory, if you are a mage.


The scribe command is only used by Mages and allows them to commit a spell scroll to their
arsenal (spell screen).

Scrolls are purchased in the Spur Merchant District along with a small chance to find some
basic spell scrolls on low leveled monsters.

(You are looking to reduce scroll/text in the game, please see the help file for CONFIG)

See: help spells, help class ats.commands.combat.CastCommand, help config, help mage

entries.title: SKILLS
entries.body:
SKILLS
Author: Command Master
Keywords: skills 
Type: Command

Syntax: skills [search] - lists all the skills you have access to. Optional search.


The skills command lists all of the skill abilities you have access to.

To use a skill ability, you use the use command.

Skills are unique, and the game will search for the skill to execute on every input. For
example, if 'kick' was typed, the game would first search for a regular kick command, and
if it did not find one, it would try to execute 'use kick' automatically.

To learn more about abilities please visit this web page:
http://tempestseason.com/manual/abilities/

See: help class ats.commands.PracticeCommand, help train, help learn, help class
ats.commands.informative.SpecializationsCommand, help use,

entries.title: TARGET
entries.body:
TARGET


Author: Command Master
Keywords: target diagnose
Type: Command

Syntax: target <target> - locks all non-AE hostile abilities and attacks onto the indicated target.


The target command allows a player to lock onto a target where all attacks and hostile
abilities(skills, spells, etc) will be directed to said target if they are present.

When a target is locked on a (Target) tag will appear by their name in the room.

NOTE: Whenever you use a hostile ability the game will automatically lock onto that target.

For healing targets, see help ally

See: help class ats.commands.combat.AllyCommand, help look, help use,

TELLCHAT

THIEF

entries.title: TRAIN
entries.body:
TRAIN
Author: Command Master
Keywords: train trainer guildlist classlist raise
Type: Command

Syntax: train list - lists the abilities and specializations that can be trained at this location.
Syntax: train <slot> - trains the ability up to the next level. This will require a tier point and sometimes an item (the train will inform you on what is needed).
Syntax: train spec <slot> - trains the specialization up to the next level. This may require a tier point and a small fee.

Syntax: train tier cost - checks the cost of the next tier point you may buy.
Syntax: train tier buy - buys a tier point for the associated gold price.
Syntax: train tier respec confirm - resets all of your tier points for 5,000 gold. All of the abilities and specializations you trained will be set to lv 1. You will receive a 75% refund of your ability points.

Syntax: train guildlist - views your standing in your classes guild.
Syntax: train history - views your training attribute gain history.


The train command raises a level of an ability, specialization, or aptitude to the next
level.

The cost of raising to the next level varies:
1. Possibly using a TIER POINT and/or money, if applicable to raise an ability in level.
2. Using a TIER point (and money, if applicable) to raise a specialization in level.


The money cost to raise an ability up a level depends on the amount of uses the ability has
left.

You gain tier points upon leveling up.

You can also buy tier points at the trainer using 'train tier buy'.

Respeccing your tier points will set all of your non-natural abilities to their initial
level.

To learn more about training and learning new abilities visit the manual:
www.tempestseason.com/manual/abilities/#Training_Abilities_and_Specializations

See: help learn, help class ats.commands.PracticeCommand, help class
ats.commands.informative.SpecializationsCommand, help tier points, help anima convergence

entries.title: UNLOAD
entries.body:
UNLOAD
Author: Command Master
Keywords: unload 
Type: Command

Syntax: unload - unloads the equipped firearm/crossbow with its bolt/magazine.
Syntax: unload <item> - unloads the indicated firearm/crossbow with its bolt/magazine. Your equipment will be checked first, then your inventory


The unload command is used to remove ammo from crossbows or firearms. The removed
projectile or magazine is placed in your inventory.

See: help fire, help reload, help ranger

entries.title: UNLOCK
entries.body:
UNLOCK
Author: Command Master
Keywords: unlock lockpick lock pick
Type: Command

Syntax: unlock <item>|<slot> [room|inv|eq]
Using 'room', 'inv', or 'eq' will ensure an item will only be from that location (the room or your inventory or eq). Optional.


The unlock command attempts to unlock a container(chest, box, etc) or portal(gate, door,
etc). Some items require keys to be unlocked, others do not.

For containers, there are three ways to unlock it:
using the key (if one exists
asking your neighborhood Rogue to pick the lock
visiting Hoss at his Locksmith Shop in the alley behind the southern section of Merchant Distirct

For portals, there are two ways to unlock it:
using the key (if one exists
asking your neighborhood Rogue to pick the lock

Not all locks can be picked.

For unlocking affects on magic items, see help detectmagic

See: help locksmith, help lock, help open, help close, help picklocks, help detectmagic

entries.title: USE
entries.body:
USE
Author: Command Master
Keywords: use 
Type: Command

Syntax: use <skill name> <target> - uses the skill on the target
Leaving <target> blank will target the caster automatically.


The use command uses a skill.

Skills typically use stamina. Stamina is restored every 20 seconds out of combat. Sleeping
is the best way to restore stamina outside of restoration abilities.

Skills are unique, and the game will search for the skill to execute on every input. For


example, if 'kick' was typed, the game would first search for a regular kick command, and
if it did not find one, it would try to execute 'use kick' automatically.

To learn more about abilities please visit this web page:
http://tempestseason.com/manual/abilities/

See: help skills,

entries.title: WEALTH
entries.body:
WEALTH
Author: Command Master
Keywords: wealth 
Type: Command

Syntax: wealth - displays the amount of money on you.


The wealth command allows you to see the money on your character.

See: help inventory, help class ats.commands.informative.ScoreCommand,

entries.title: WIELD
entries.body:
WIELD
Author: Command Master
Keywords: wield 
Type: Command

SSyntax: wield <item>|<slot> - wields the item in the primary slot.

See help: dualwield


The wield command tries to equip a weapon in the primary or secondary slot.

A weapon is needed to perform any melee attacks and to parry. Some skills may also require
an equipped weapon.

Some weapons can be swapped between 1 hand and 2 hand. To do this, use the grip command.
Gripped one handed weapons receive a damage bonus compared to one handed weapons but less
than fully fledged 2 handed weapons.


Not all classes can dual wield.

To dual wield a weapon, see help dualwield

See: help dualwield, help grip, help class ats.commands.informative.AttackInfoCommand, help
wear, help hold, help remove, help equipment, help inventory, help inspect,
